tasks.notes: Direct static central-claim review. No repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The test does not measure total build time or runtime memory. It parametrizes Release/static and Debug/shared, builds with Visual Studio 15 and Ninja, checks for .lib versus .dll output, runs the app, and validates compiler/runtime details (test/functional/toolchains/cmake/test_ninja.py:87-118). Since both build configuration and linkage change together, the test cannot isolate a shared-versus-static performance effect or establish which is faster or uses less memory.

material_errors: Central newer branch is correct, but initial-install result incorrectly says local_remote_rev at T1; test explicitly downloads default_remote_rev.
tasks.notes: Direct static central-claim review. No repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The test uploads one revision to default, sleeps, uploads a modified revision to local, clears the cache, and first downloads default_remote_rev. An unrestricted --update then selects local_remote_rev, after which --update -r default reports that cached revision as Newer (test/integration/remote/multi_remote_test.py:123-144). The proxy sets RECIPE_NEWER when revisions differ and the cached timestamp is at least the selected remote timestamp; it retains the cached recipe and clears remote (conan/internal/graph/proxy.py:73-88).
